relationships.subject: Shentong Zhuyu decoction
relationships.evidence_quote: STZYD ameliorates RTX-induced mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia in rats by suppressing inflammation and DRG cell apoptosis through the inhibition of the cAMP/PKA/p-CREB signaling axis.

relationships.subject: 8-Br-cAMP
relationships.evidence_quote: Pharmacological activation of PKA by 8-Br-cAMP counteracted the protective effect of SDZYD in PHN rats.

key_findings: STZYD relieved RTX-induced PHN allodynia and hyperalgesia, lowering TRPV1, cytokines and DRG apoptosis.
Effects depended on inhibition of cAMP/PKA/p-CREB; PKA activation reversed benefit.
